snippet.title: Synergy - Tetsujin Returns - 1996
snippet.description:
For those who want to rememorate this mecha first person shooter (FPS) game that was Tetsujin Returns (also known as Iron Angel of the Apocalypse The Return and as 鉄人リターンズ) developed and published by Synergy in 1996.
